subject.title: fix(agents): apply stale-run liveness check to aborted subagent orphan recovery

question: Should `terminalOwner: "interrupted-recovery"` remain the durable exact-run terminal authority after current-main cooperative suspension is integrated?
rationale: This persisted lifecycle choice determines upgrade behavior, restart replay, and whether late provider, yield, or suspension callbacks may replace the terminal outcome.

options.title: Keep durable exact-run authority
options.body: Integrate suspension as pre-terminal state, retain exact run-ID finalization, and prove the resolved head.

options.title: Use existing terminal fields
options.body: Keep exact-generation targeting but remove the serialized owner and re-prove persistence, retry, and callback-race guarantees.

options.title: Prepare a replacement
options.body: Use a smaller current-main-native patch only if resolving this branch would discard most of its tested lifecycle work.

recommendation.title: Keep durable exact-run authority
recommendation.body: Integrate suspension as pre-terminal state, retain exact run-ID finalization, and prove the resolved head.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to the PR and authored both the durable recovery design and the overlapping suspension implementation.
